labels.rationale: Manually re-audited at the pin: kindFilter is consumed only in the category slot (260-267), but the original owner also refreshes DateFilterView in the date slot (278-296). DateFilterView reads new Date() at 717 and derives Calendar.endMonth at 743. A kind-only update after a year boundary refreshes the original calendar's permitted end year; moving the subscription into the category slot leaves the mounted date panel stale. This disproves the former positive practice label. The fresh dateRange allocation at 70, created by packages/datetime/src/datetime.ts:75-94, also invalidates the independent memo dependencies on every original owner render. Retain the existing owner-work guard rather than treating independent memo inputs as stable. Removing the invalid positive label leaves any future emitted change at this location subject to ordinary unlabeled-practice precision failure.
